companyDescription: The S&P 500 in one fund — 500 leading US companies. 0.03% cost, first ETF to cross $1T AUM. Classic DCA core.
priceNote: S&P 500 ค่าธรรมเนียม 0.03% · AUM ~$1T — มาตรฐาน DCA
summary: VOO tracks the S&P 500 — 500 leading US companies — at a 0.03% expense ratio, the benchmark DCA core that recently became the first ETF to top $1T in assets. Marginally less diversified than VTI and at a similar full-market valuation, but the gold-standard hands-off accumulation fund.

catalysts.name: S&P 500 compounding
